name: Grid Run
description:
Execute a NEW operation and return its result. Use for normal catalog/asset invocation, not to poll or retrieve an existing Job: call the separately advertised Job-status or Job-result operation directly with that Job's id. The operation argument accepts an exact resolvable reference: v/ops/json/merge (venue catalog), o/my-pipeline (your pin), a/<hash> (asset), or did:web:<venue>/a/<hash> (definition fetched from the publishing venue, executed where this op runs). Never construct an operation path by reversing or splitting a provider-facing tool name; use a reference obtained from catalog metadata, config, or the task. To execute ON another venue, pass its URL or DID in the venue argument. Pass input matching the operation's schema. Blocks until complete; use the separately advertised asynchronous invocation operation for long-running work.

Requires invoke on the requested operation reference or a containing operation tree. This is permission to look up and start that operation, not permission to access its underlying resources. The operation enforces those permissions under the caller authority at the execution venue. A direct tool binding to an operation does not itself require invoke; this tool does because it accepts an arbitrary operation reference.

operation.description: Operation reference. Any resolvable form: v/ops/<adapter>/<op>, o/<name>, hex hash, /a/<hash>, or DID URL. Use covia_list path=v/ops to discover what's available.

input.description: Arguments matching the operation's input schema (any JSON value — object, array, string, number, boolean, or null). Use covia_read path=v/ops/<adapter>/<op> to inspect the schema if unsure.

venue.description: Optional remote venue URL or DID. Omit to run on this venue.

authenticateAs.description: Explicit remote authentication mode. caller requires a target-audienced empty-att identity credential; venue is only for the venue itself. UCAN grant presence never selects a mode.

output.description: The operation's output (shape determined by the operation's output schema)
